comparisons.reason: Same sources and any/binary form, but the quoted material differs. Feature 0 counts only quotes of a specific factual claim, excludes opinion or value claims, and requires a refutation that argues the claim is false, inaccurate or unsupported. Feature 1 counts any quoted word, phrase or sentence from the OP, with no factual-claim restriction, and any dispute of it. Feature 1 is therefore broader, and the factual-claim eligibility gate in feature 0 is a material scope difference.
